metadata.description: Retrieve details of a specific task series using its unique identifier.
metadata.learn_more: Retrieve details of a specific task series using its unique identifier. This endpoint allows you to access the properties and series information associated with the specified taskId. It's useful for obtaining detailed information about a task series, including any custom properties.

taskId.label: Task Id
taskId.description: The unique identifier of the task series to retrieve. This is required to specify which task series you are interested in.

properties.label: Properties
properties.description: A comma-separated list of property names to include in the response. This allows you to specify which properties of the task series you want to retrieve.
